inspected = ["docs/research/reference-antaresian-reliquary.md §1–§7", "Package and member paths, sizes and SHA-256 computed from the downloaded archive (nothing executed)", "Bundled ANTA_REQ.txt: release 2020/08/24, author antares031, Boom, Doom 2, 7 maps, Dehacked/BEX Patch: Yes, CC BY-NC 4.0", "WAD lump listing: 1,499 lumps, nine map markers, DEHACKED (24,232 bytes), ZMAPINFO/DECORATE/LANGUAGE, no COMPLVL and no UMAPINFO", "Cacowards 2020 Top Ten page 1: https://www.doomworld.com/cacowards/2020/best1/", "DoomWiki (archived): https://web.archive.org/web/20251119110641/https://doomwiki.org/wiki/Antaresian_Reliquary"]
notes = "Confirmed archive and member identities by downloading the archive from three byte-identical mirrors and reading its member list; nothing from the archive was executed. The archive has exactly two root members, ANTA_REQ.txt and ANTA_REQ.wad. The WAD is a PWAD with 1,499 lumps and nine map markers (MAP01–MAP07, MAP31, MAP32); the separate DEHACKED lump (24,232 bytes) holds the weapon/monster changes and is loaded automatically with the WAD, so no -deh entry is needed. No COMPLVL or UMAPINFO lump exists; the ZMAPINFO/DECORATE/LANGUAGE lumps are ZDoom-only and inert under DSDA-Doom v0.30.1 (ZDoom MAPINFO support was removed in v0.30.0), so the recipe declares complevel boom from the author's Boom-compatible text. The author notes a death exit on every level and recommends forced pistol starts. No gameplay test was performed. Tags: cacowards = 2020 Top Ten page 1 (https://www.doomworld.com/cacowards/2020/best1/); episode = nine maps, matching DoomWiki's nine-level description and the tag's nine-or-fewer rule; classics = released 2020-08-24, over five years before this review. The Cacowards page and the author's TXT say '7 maps', while the WAD and DoomWiki list nine map slots; the seven compilation maps are MAP01–MAP06 and MAP31, with MAP07 and MAP32 as the two added levels. The MAP31 performance warning is an explicit owner request (2026-10-21) based on the owner's knowledge, not a DDL measurement of FPS or enemy count."
limitations = ["Needs Deck Validation: IWAD/complevel, load order, gameplay and audio.", "DSDA-Doom ignores the bundled ZMAPINFO, so the author's ZDoom map names/next-map links and MAP31 ending text do not appear; MAP31/MAP32 are bonus slots that need -warp or IDCLEV until DDL exposes level selection.
